action.objective: Complete broad search over all legal moves at depth 3-4 to identify the best reply to Black's h6, with attention to the hanging d4 pawn and the g5 bishop.
action.rationale: Black just played h7h6, attacking the g5 bishop and its pin on the d4 pawn chain. Broad search is required first; I use half the node budget (3000) at target depth 3-4 to rank all roots before selecting a candidate for verification.
